description: A Next-Gen game patched to Old-Gen with Keep Backups clicked off (saved, SET-7): Fallout4.exe is restored from a valid _upgradeBackup, which empties the queue in the middle of the loop, so the Overview refresh, the re-detection and the re-enabled button happen before the launcher is looked at (the 'finished' step). The launcher's identical _downgradeBackup replaces it and its patch, already in the working directory, is applied at once without a download and deleted; steam_api64's stale backup and invalid Old-Gen backup are deleted and its patch downloaded, as is the Creation Kit's, with the button enabled throughout; Archive2.exe isn't there; Archive2Interop.dll is restored, then deleting its read-only identical backup fails (Patched, then Failed patching).

deviations.reason: Patch All is enabled exactly when no patch is queued or running, not by whether the loop's last file needed a patch.
